about: START-HERE-Claude.md checklist items (§4, §5, §6, §7.1, §7.2, §10) against the shipped atlas at b69212c. status: TRUE (already true), PARTIAL, NOT_YET (would be new work), NA (no such exercise or feature in the app), CONFLICT (with 02-design.md, binding; decision needed). Paths are repo-relative.

s4_normalization.item: Resolve all existing catalog IDs through a mapping table; preserve historical IDs
s4_normalization.evidence: Catalog ids are literal and never reused (client/src/lib/exerciseCatalogForearm.ts:8-11); mappings are by catalog id, no name matching (shared/specialization/regions/forearm/mappings.ts:6-7; 02-design.md:34). The package-to-catalog table is reconciliation.json (scratch), not in the repo.

s4_normalization.item: Treat fa-* as external seed IDs, not replacements
s4_normalization.evidence: No fa-* id anywhere outside the package. Variants are cat-<catalogId> (02-design.md:24); a fa-* id would be provenance only.
No field for it; reconciliation.json keeps original_candidate per record.

s4_normalization.item: Alias candidate 22 to 12; no duplicate exercise or dose
s4_normalization.evidence: fa-12 and fa-22 both resolve to catalog 411 One-Arm Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl (variants/forearm.ts:131); no second row is needed.
No wrist machine row in the catalog.

s4_normalization.item: Split candidate 50 (rice bucket) into individually logged actions
Resolve 7, 10, 13, 27, 39, 40 before scoring; block ambiguous protocols
s4_normalization.evidence: The same principle shipped for the wrist roller: one row per winding direction (415, 416) beside the undirected 141, which gets only shared contributing credit (exerciseCatalogForearm.ts:18-21; mappings.ts:191-226). Ambiguous rows stay region-level with a reason (regions/forearm/unmapped.ts:304-329). The six package candidates themselves are unresolved.

s4_normalization.item: Correct candidate 17: pronation is toward palm-down
s4_normalization.evidence: 405 Lever Pronation: 'the forearm turns palm-down against the load's leverage' (variants/forearm.ts:136).

s4_normalization.item: Require an offset lever for dumbbell rotation
s4_normalization.evidence: 405/406 hold 'a handle loaded at one end (or a hammer)' (variants/forearm.ts:136-137); no credit for a dumbbell turned about its own handle (mappings.ts:24-26; 05-mappings.md:35).

s4_normalization.item: For deviation, confirm the resistance vector opposes the motion
s4_normalization.evidence: 407/408: arm straight at the side, weight in front / behind, the wrist tilts it up (variants/forearm.ts:132-133).

s4_normalization.item: Candidate 23: rope variant separately if the action differs
s4_normalization.evidence: No cable wrist-curl (flexion) row. Related defect: the catalog defines the rope cable hammer curl twice (134, 337; variants/forearm.ts:109, 115).

s4_normalization.item: Candidate 16: keep phase information; no full pronator/supinator credit
s4_normalization.evidence: Zottman 136: BR direct, the turn not credited to PT/PQ/supinator (mappings.ts:259-264); forearmOrientation 'changing' (variants/forearm.ts:111). Phases are not stored as separate phases (phase 'concentric_eccentric').
Gripper split into 402 Gripper Close (dynamic) and 403 Gripper Hold (seconds, deliberate) (variants/forearm.ts:141-142; mappings.ts:288-289). No ball-squeeze row.

s4_normalization.item: Fingertip support: keep hand/finger context; never divide body mass
Grip-target holds deliberate; compound lifts incidental unless a hold is programmed
s4_normalization.evidence: Holds: measure seconds, deliberateHold true (variants/forearm.ts:88-92); pulls/hinges/shrugs incidental grip (mappings.ts:247-249, 314-330); test forearmMappings.test.ts:41.

s4_normalization.item: Record machine identity, grip attachment, straps, assistance, laterality, load convention
s4_normalization.evidence: Variant grip, straps, laterality, elbow angle (shared/specialization/types.ts:306-335); straps and side per set in the logger (02-design.md:85-87); load convention per catalog id (shared/loadConventions.ts:28, 55). No machine identity, no assistance field (client/src/lib/deviceWorkoutLog.ts:193 lists the known set fields), no handle-diameter dimension.

s4_normalization.item: Complete every Exercise-review-ledger checkbox or document a blocker
s4_normalization.evidence: 57 x 5 = 285 boxes, all unchecked in the package.

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: No rep optima from guessed fiber types
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: The atlas has no per-muscle rep field; app-wide rep anchors are population-level (client/src/lib/trainingEvidence.ts:1-4).

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Do not equate anatomical function with training response
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: Mapping rationales and sources say 'EMG is not growth' (mappings.ts:59-66); appearance claims are labelled inference (regions/forearm/review.ts:342-343).

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Keep weekly targets unset unless the user or a reviewed program supplies them
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: 'There is no default target and no automatic increase' (02-design.md:76); brief11.test.ts:271 'Goal unset → no fake deficit'.

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: No universal 15+ sets target; no automatic 19-muscle escalation
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: 02-design.md:76; 'Nothing is suggested only to raise a number' (02-design.md:131).

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Gradual user-directed progression, not compulsory increases
Store ROM/technique qualifiers when available; never infer ROM from a name
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: Descriptive dimension 'range' exists for variants (shared/specialization/variants/dimensions.ts:39); nothing is recorded per set.
Set effort is its own field (deviceWorkoutLog.ts:40, 229); unrecorded effort stays unknown (rules.ts:39); bouts.test.ts:81.

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Show load/rep improvements only for comparable exercise/equipment/assistance/technique
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: Measured bests per exercise, and grip readings only against readings taken the same way (09-page.md:101); assistance is not recorded.

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Never equate machine stacks, gripper ratings, cable stacks and kg
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: Gripper rating treated as a number read off the implement, not a mass (shared/loadConventions.ts:24-25); 'Load × reps is external volume-load, not muscle force' (rules.ts:38).

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Preserve historical values when defaults change
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: Published mapping and rule versions immutable (02-design.md:151); the 119 variants frozen (variants/forearm.ts:9-12).

s5_rep_effort_progression.item: Never alter strength percentiles or rankings
s5_rep_effort_progression.evidence: 'Strength estimates, volume and percentiles skip hold sets' (02-design.md:89); the atlas writes nothing to ranking code.

s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: No tendon view exists (no 'tendon' in client/src/components/specialization or shared/specialization outside anatomy claim text).

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Explain mapped exposure is incomplete and does not measure strain
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: 'No number here predicts growth, recovery or injury' (rules.ts:41).

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Separate medial elbow, lateral elbow, wrist/thumb and digital views
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: We have no tissue unit or regional group model; package muscles.json tissue_units/regional_groups would be new data (and new anatomy claims to review).

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Deduplicate shared-region bouts; no summed muscle-grade heatmaps
s6_tendon_exposure.status: TRUE for the region total; NOT_YET for tissue regions
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: Region total = distinct bouts, not the sum of rows (rules.ts:36; brief11.test.ts:129, 318).
No symptom entry; 02-design.md:79 'No new questionnaire' (notes are the existing session note).

s6_tendon_exposure.item: 'Not enough information' when tracking is incomplete
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: Completeness counts exist (shared/specialization/exposure.ts:598, 616); hatching for unreviewed (02-design.md:62, 100). No 'complete week' concept, which the baseline needs.

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Let users inspect source workouts behind a change
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: Contribution ledger exercise → bout → segment (02-design.md:106); no workload-change view yet.

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Neutral prompt to review a new or rapidly changed workload
Never label no symptoms / no logged work as 'safe'
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: rules.ts:41; empty outline means 'mapped, no work' (02-design.md:62).

s6_tendon_exposure.item: Never encourage pushing through pain to meet an exposure target
Reduce, replace or defer a planned exercise from this screen
s6_tendon_exposure.evidence: Add or Swap with Undo (02-design.md:108; client/src/components/specialization/PlanChangeSheet.tsx:23-30, 171). No reduce or defer.

s6_tendon_exposure.item: No individualized injury-prevention or rehab prescriptions

s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.item: Locate catalog tables, muscle ids, logger events, calculation owners
s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.evidence: Catalog client/src/lib/exerciseCatalog*.ts; muscle ids shared/specialization/regions/forearm/ids.ts:13-33; calculator shared/specialization/exposure.ts; owners 02-design.md:183-194.

s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.item: Read the existing atlas and 3D briefs
s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.evidence: 02-design.md:196-216 (renderer contract; the 3D viewer's kebab-case mesh ids are the package's muscle ids).

Computed on demand from current records, no ledger table (01-reconciliation.md:17; 02-design.md:146); memoized by a key that includes source revisions and the rule and mapping versions (client/src/lib/specialization/useSpecializationSummary.ts:26, 52, 61).

s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.item: Ownership / RLS patterns and migration conventions
s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.evidence: 02-design.md:156-168; reference rows are public-read when reviewed or published; goals/measurements owner-only; PGlite tested under anon, user A, user B, service (02-design.md:15).

s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.item: Do not duplicate a concept under a new name
s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.evidence: Package buckets map onto our categories (vocabulary in the summary); tissue units and grades have no existing equivalent.

s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.item: Import into staging first; no production enablement of drafts
s7_1_inspect_then_adapt.evidence: 'There is no staging database, so PGlite is the only rehearsal' (02-design.md:168). The equivalent shipped mechanism: a draft mapping version and draft rows that are hidden and never counted (02-design.md:152; types.ts:380-386).

s7_2_import_contract.evidence: variant_mappings unique (version_id, mapping_key) and (version_id, variant_key, node_id, action_id) (supabase/migrations/20261016120000_specialization_atlas_schema.sql:309-310).

s7_2_import_contract.item: Grades null or 0-4; index = 25 x grade
Reject unknown muscle ids; never map by display name
Alias chains cycle-free, resolve to canonical
s7_2_import_contract.evidence: Node parent cycles refused (02-design.md:149); variants can 'replace' another (types.ts:307-311); no exercise alias concept (fa-22 needs none: same catalog row).

s7_2_import_contract.item: Provenance and mapping version in derived output

s7_2_import_contract.evidence: Seed generated from TS with a drift test (02-design.md:164); no inserted/updated/skipped/blocked report.
Drafts hidden and never counted (02-design.md:152; rules.ts:35; exposure.test.ts:188).

s7_2_import_contract.item: Symptom data out of analytics and share cards
Rollback to the previous mapping version without losing raw logs
s7_2_import_contract.evidence: Raw logs are device sessions; versions are immutable and the page reads the region's current version (exposure.ts:220). No rollback procedure written.

s7_2_import_contract.item: Recompute history on activation; no re-entry
Resumable backfill with a completion report
Invalidate caches after edits, deletes, swaps, version changes
s7_2_import_contract.evidence: useSpecializationSummary.ts:52 (key includes source revisions and versions); bouts.test.ts:205; brief11.test.ts:240.

s10_release_gates.evidence: 16/16 pass. Under python3 -I the literal 'python3 -I -m unittest -v test_model' fails (isolated mode drops cwd from sys.path); 'python3 -I -m unittest discover -s <pkg> -p test_model.py -v' passes.

Not covered: package Example C (unknown protocol as one unresolved bout: we have region-level unclassified, rules.ts:35), Example D (no thumb-extension credit from curls/carries: true by mappings, no named test), warm-up tendon count, workload baseline.
